resolvedFindings.resolution: Test-session and unavailable-access messages precede the missing-key branch.
Test-session or unavailable-access state precedes missing-key welcome; retry is offered only outside the test session.

verifiedBySourceInspection: Replacement updates only kSecValueData, preserving existing access control; no replacement path deletes an item.
Only item-not-found permits add; duplicate-add retries update once. Write failures propagate without deletion.
Read/presence queries distinguish missing from unavailable; malformed successful read is decode failure.
AppState routes all credential operations through one dependency; failed writes/removals preserve known presence.
Availability refresh changes validation revisions; stale asynchronous validation results cannot replace refreshed state.
Active-run guard precedes credential guards; duplicate generate does not replace active generation state.
Settings retains entered key after a failed save; unavailable prompts and footers do not imply absence.
Disabled test store cannot reach live Security; validation and generation stop before credential reads in test sessions.
forLaunch accepts either explicit test environment or immutable bundle flag; Bool and NSString flag representations are handled.
Fake-only tests cover failure paths, separate account namespaces, absence classification, disabled live requests, active-run guard, and manually launched test-host flag.
